vulnerability_type: CWE-94 code injection through arbitrary module import
root_cause: An unauthenticated path parameter is propagated as an agent name into importlib.import_module without an allowlist or trusted-root restriction.
impact: A remote unauthenticated caller can select an importable module whose top-level behavior executes code in the ADK web server process.
recommendation: Authenticate development endpoints and resolve agents only from a pre-enumerated trusted registry instead of importing caller-controlled names.
